name: Semantic Scholar
description: Free research tool for searching scholarly literature across disciplines, with citation contexts, paper recommendations, and author profiles. Operated by the Allen Institute for Artificial Intelligence.

name: Google Scholar
description: Web search engine indexing scholarly literature across disciplines and source types, including journal articles, theses, books, and abstracts, with citation counts and links to related and citing works.

name: BASE (Bielefeld Academic Search Engine)
description: Multidisciplinary search engine operated by Bielefeld University Library that indexes open access content from academic repositories and journals worldwide, with an OAI-PMH interface for data reuse.

name: CORE
description: Aggregator of open access research outputs from repositories and journals worldwide, providing search plus a public API for metadata and full texts. Developed as a not-for-profit service based in the United Kingdom.

name: OpenAIRE Explore
description: Search portal over the OpenAIRE Graph, linking publications, datasets, software, and other research products, with strong coverage of outputs from European funded research.

name: Dimensions
description: Research information platform from Digital Science covering publications, grants, patents, datasets, and policy documents with linked analytics. Free personal accounts for non-commercial use and paid plans for organizations.
access_requirements: Personal accounts are free for non-commercial use; organizations pay for advanced features

name: Lens
description: Independent search platform combining scholarly literature with patent data, offering citation linkage, collections, and analysis tools. Individual scholarly search is free after registration and the API is subscription based.
access_requirements: Individual scholarly search is free with registration; the Lens API is subscription based

name: Scopus
description: Citation database of peer reviewed literature across science, technology, medicine, social sciences, and arts and humanities, published by Elsevier with author, affiliation, and journal metrics.

name: Web of Science
description: Subscription citation index covering journals, conference proceedings, and books across disciplines, maintained by Clarivate with cited reference searching and journal level metrics.

name: ERIC
description: Education literature database sponsored by the Institute of Education Sciences of the United States Department of Education, indexing journal articles, reports, and other education research materials with full text for many documents.
publisher: Institute of Education Sciences, U.S. Department of Education

name: PubMed
description: Citation and abstract database of biomedical and life sciences literature maintained by the United States National Library of Medicine, with MeSH subject headings and links to full text.

name: PubMed Central
description: Free full text archive of biomedical and life sciences journal literature at the United States National Institutes of Health, including deposits made under public access policies.

name: JSTOR
description: Digital library of academic journals, books, and primary sources across disciplines, operated by the nonprofit ITHAKA. Access is mainly by subscription with a free monthly online reading allowance for independent researchers.
access_requirements: Institutional subscription for most content; a free personal account allows limited monthly online reading

name: CNKI
description: China National Knowledge Infrastructure, the major Chinese academic database covering journals, dissertations, conference proceedings, and newspapers from Chinese publishers.

name: J-STAGE
description: Platform of the Japan Science and Technology Agency for publishing Japanese scholarly journals across science, technology, medicine, and humanities, with a large share of open access content.

name: ResearchRabbit
description: Visual literature mapping tool that links papers through citations and shared references, helping researchers follow related work and author networks. Free for individual researchers with an account.

name: Connected Papers
description: Tool that builds a similarity graph around a seed paper using co-citation and bibliographic coupling, helping researchers survey an area and identify prior and derivative work.

name: Litmaps
description: Literature discovery tool that visualizes citation networks around seed articles and monitors new relevant publications over time, with free and paid plans.

name: Open Knowledge Maps
description: Nonprofit service that creates visual topic overviews from open scholarly metadata, clustering search results from sources such as BASE and PubMed into thematic groups.

name: IDEAS
description: Bibliographic service of the RePEc volunteer initiative dedicated to economics, indexing working papers, journal articles, and book chapters from participating archives worldwide.

name: IEEE Xplore
description: Digital library of IEEE and partner publications covering electrical engineering, electronics, computer science, and related fields, with journals, conference papers, and standards.

name: ACM Digital Library
description: Collection of publications of the Association for Computing Machinery, including journals, conference proceedings, and magazines covering computing research and practice.

name: X-MOL
description: Chinese research platform for literature tracking and journal awareness with strength in chemistry, offering journal feeds, paper search, and science career information in Chinese and English.

name: PubScholar
description: Open access academic resource platform of the Chinese Academy of Sciences that integrates open scholarly literature, patent data, and other publicly available research resources.

name: Unpaywall
description: Free tool and API from OurResearch that locates legal open access copies of scholarly articles using DOIs, built on a database of open access content harvested from journals and repositories.
best_for: Finding open access copies of articles
Checking open access status by DOI

name: Crossref
description: Registration agency for Digital Object Identifiers used by scholarly publishers, maintaining DOI metadata, reference linking, and funder and license information. Public API metadata is released under CC0.

name: DataCite
description: Global membership organization and registration agency for DOIs assigned to research data, software, samples, and other scholarly outputs, with open metadata released under CC0.

name: OpenAlex
description: Open catalog of scholarly papers, authors, institutions, venues, and concepts, created by OurResearch as the successor to Microsoft Academic Graph and released as CC0 data with a free API.

name: DOI System
description: Entry point for the Digital Object Identifier system managed by the DOI Foundation, providing DOI resolution, handbook documentation, and information for registration agencies and users.

name: ISSN Portal
description: Search interface of the ISSN International Centre for the international register of serial publications, providing ISSN records, title histories, and links to related resources.

name: ORCID
description: Nonprofit registry providing persistent identifiers for researchers and contributors, linking publications, funding, and affiliations. Public data is released under CC0 through an open API.

name: ROR
description: Open registry of persistent identifiers for research organizations worldwide, maintained by a community partnership and released as CC0 data with an API.

name: Wikidata
description: Collaborative knowledge base of the Wikimedia movement storing structured data about entities including scholarly works, authors, and institutions, with SPARQL query access and CC0 data.

name: ISNI
description: International Standard Name Identifier registry assigning persistent identifiers to the public identities of researchers, creators, publishers, and organizations, managed by the ISNI International Agency.

name: VIAF
description: Virtual International Authority File, an OCLC hosted service clustering name authority records from national libraries and other agencies to connect variants of the same person, place, or organization.

name: WorldCat
description: Public catalog of library collections worldwide maintained by OCLC, letting users locate books, journals, and other items and find libraries that hold them.

name: Google Books
description: Search and preview service for digitized books and magazines, with full text search of scanned volumes, bibliographic records, and links to sellers and libraries. Includes the Google Books API.

name: HathiTrust Digital Library
description: Large scale digital library preserving digitized content from research libraries, with public domain works openly readable and controlled digital access options for member institutions.

name: OpenCitations
description: Open infrastructure publishing open scholarly citation data, including the OpenCitations Corpus and the COCI index of Crossref cited references, released under CC0 with REST APIs.

name: CiNii Research
description: Scholarly information service of the National Institute of Informatics in Japan covering articles, books, theses, and research data from Japanese institutions, with OpenSearch APIs for reuse.

name: dblp
description: Curated open bibliography of computer science publications indexing journals, conference proceedings, and author records, operated by Schloss Dagstuhl, Leibniz Center for Informatics, with open data and APIs.
publisher: Schloss Dagstuhl, Leibniz Center for Informatics

name: zbMATH Open
description: Open access reviewing and abstracting database for mathematics literature operated by FIZ Karlsruhe, covering publications in pure and applied mathematics with reviewer metadata.

name: Library of Congress Online Catalog
description: Public catalog of the United States Library of Congress collections covering books, serials, maps, manuscripts, and other materials, with authority records and standard subject headings.

name: BnF Catalogue general
description: General catalog of the Bibliothèque nationale de France covering printed and audiovisual materials, with authority data and links to digitized documents in Gallica.

name: ISBN International
description: Official site of the International ISBN Agency providing ISBN standard documentation, the registration group directory, and guidance on ISBN assignment for books and monographs.

name: DOAJ
description: Community curated directory that indexes open access journals meeting basic quality criteria, with metadata on licensing, peer review, article processing charges, and abstracts available through a public API.

name: PLOS
description: Nonprofit open access publisher of peer reviewed journals across biology, medicine, and related sciences, including PLOS ONE, with articles published under open licenses.
attribution_requirements: Source and license attribution required for reuse

name: eLife
description: Nonprofit open access journal publishing research in the life sciences and biomedicine, known for public peer review and a publishing model built around reviewed preprints.
attribution_requirements: Source and license attribution required for reuse

name: Frontiers
description: Open access publisher of peer reviewed journals across science, engineering, humanities, and health, headquartered in Switzerland and funded through article processing charges.
attribution_requirements: Source and license attribution required for reuse

name: MDPI
description: Publisher of a large portfolio of open access journals across physical sciences, engineering, biology, medicine, and social sciences, based in Basel, Switzerland.
best_for: Open access journals across many fields
attribution_requirements: Source and license attribution required for reuse

name: Copernicus Publications
description: Open access publisher based in Germany specializing in geosciences and adjacent fields, operating interactive public peer review for many of its journals.
attribution_requirements: Source and license attribution required for reuse

name: Open Library of Humanities
description: Publisher of open access journals in the humanities funded through a library consortium model rather than article processing charges, based in the United Kingdom.
attribution_requirements: Source and license attribution required for reuse

name: SciELO
description: Program and network publishing open access journals from Latin America, the Caribbean, Iberia, and partner countries, with national collection sites on shared infrastructure.

name: Redalyc
description: Open access information system indexing and hosting journals from Latin America, Spain, and Portugal, with a focus on social sciences and humanities and visibility for regional research.
publisher: Universidad Autónoma del Estado de México

name: African Journals Online
description: Platform hosting scholarly journals published in Africa, providing tables of contents, abstracts, and article access, with many open access titles and some pay per view options.

name: Sherpa Romeo
description: Registry of publisher open access policies summarizing whether and how authors can archive manuscripts of individual journals, maintained by Jisc in the United Kingdom.

name: DOAB
description: Directory of Open Access Books listing peer reviewed academic books from trusted publishers, operated by the OAPEN Foundation with metadata available for reuse.

name: OAPEN
description: Repository of open access academic books operated by the OAPEN Foundation in the Netherlands, supporting peer reviewed monographs and collections across disciplines.

name: Episciences
description: Overlay journal platform from the CCSD of CNRS where journals are built on papers already available in open archives such as arXiv and HAL, with community peer review workflows.
best_for: Peer reviewed overlays of open archives
publisher: Centre pour la Communication Scientifique Directe (CNRS)

name: SPARC
description: Coalition of libraries and campus organizations advocating for open access, open data, and open education, publishing policy guides and resources for the research community.

name: OASPA
description: Open Access Scholarly Publishing Association, a membership organization of publishers and service providers that promotes standards and good practices in open access publishing.

name: Latindex
description: Regional cooperation network with an index system for Ibero-American scholarly journals, applying quality criteria and providing searchable directory information in Spanish and Portuguese.

name: AmeliCA
description: Cooperative of universities and journals promoting sustainable open access publishing in Latin America and the Global South, with shared resources, training, and a journal network.

name: Persée
description: Portal providing open access digitized collections of French journals and books in the humanities and social sciences, maintained by a consortium of French research institutions.

name: OpenEdition Journals
description: Platform for open access journals in the humanities and social sciences operated by OpenEdition, a French infrastructure combining CNRS and university partners, with multilingual content.

name: arXiv
description: Open access repository of preprints in physics, mathematics, computer science, quantitative biology, and related fields, operated by Cornell University with subject moderation and public APIs.

name: bioRxiv
description: Preprint server for biology and the life sciences operated by Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory, allowing researchers to share manuscripts before peer review, with a documented API.

name: medRxiv
description: Preprint server for health sciences including medicine, nursing, and public health, operated by Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory with a screening process and a documented API.

name: ChemRxiv
description: Preprint server for chemistry owned and operated by the American Chemical Society on the Cambridge Open Engage platform, covering all fields of chemical research.

name: SocArXiv
description: Open archive for social science preprints hosted on the Open Science Framework, covering sociology, economics, political science, and related disciplines.

name: PsyArXiv
description: Community run preprint server for psychological research hosted on the Open Science Framework, accepting preprints and working papers across psychology subfields.

name: EdArXiv
description: Preprint server for education research hosted on the Open Science Framework, run by a volunteer community to make education scholarship openly available earlier.

name: EarthArXiv
description: Community preprint server for earth sciences hosted by the California Digital Library, covering geology, geophysics, climate, and adjacent disciplines.

name: Cambridge Open Engage
description: Open platform from Cambridge University Press for hosting preprints, conference proceedings, and other early research outputs, with DOIs and community spaces for societies.

name: SSRN
description: Repository and network for working papers and early research in social sciences, economics, law, and finance, owned by Elsevier. Reading most full texts requires a free account.
access_requirements: A free account is required to download most full texts

name: Zenodo
description: General purpose open repository operated by CERN that hosts publications, preprints, datasets, software, and reports with persistent identifiers and a public REST API.

name: Open Science Framework
description: Free repository and project platform from the Center for Open Science for hosting preprints, data, materials, and registrations, with public project pages and an API.

name: Research Square
description: Preprint platform operated by Research Square that hosts standalone preprints and In Review postings of journal submissions, with screening and author controls.

name: Preprints.org
description: Multidisciplinary preprint server operated by MDPI, offering early posting of manuscripts across sciences, medicine, and social sciences with DOI assignment.

name: TechRxiv
description: Preprint server for technology, engineering, and computer science sponsored by IEEE, with author controlled posting and moderation for scope and basic quality.

name: HAL
description: French national open archive operated by the CCSD of CNRS for self archiving publications, theses, and datasets across all disciplines, with an open API.
publisher: Centre pour la Communication Scientifique Directe (CNRS)

name: NBER Working Papers
description: Working paper series of the United States National Bureau of Economic Research, a major channel for early economics research findings, with open abstracts and varied full text access.

name: ChinaXiv
description: Preprint repository operated by the National Science Library of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, hosting preprints from Chinese and international researchers across disciplines.
